decisions.reason: Dispensing through both spouts is a separate demonstration criterion already represented by the candidate's message-238 MODIFY; the speed-adjustment criterion does not change dispensing behavior.
Requiring a demonstration of working speed adjustment does not alter the existing splash-control targets or high-speed mitigation requirements.
Simultaneous operation of both stations is a separate demonstration criterion already represented by the candidate's message-238 MODIFY; the speed-adjustment criterion adds no change to it.
The source requires showing functional speed adjustment but does not change the required mixing texture, foam consistency, or smoothness.
Continuous operation for several minutes is a distinct acceptance condition already represented at message 238; the speed-adjustment criterion does not modify it.
Demonstrating working speed adjustment does not change the selected whisk design, material, size, or powder compatibility.
The source adds no new whisk-positioning or tuning requirement; it only requires demonstration of the existing speed-control behavior.
The speed-adjustment demonstration criterion does not change bowl capacity, depth, geometry, or refill policy.
The source does not revise compatibility requirements for motors, controllers, power components, mechanical interfaces, or lighting.
A demonstration of working speed adjustment does not necessarily change the required wiring-plan content or level of detail.
The source does not change the required electrical headroom, simultaneous load set, or cooling behavior.
The speed-adjustment acceptance condition does not modify structural rigidity, vibration control, or operational stability.
